recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast duotone composition featuring a band of four men sitting on a horizontal structure, set against a solid pink background with oversized, outlined bubble typography dominating the top third.
coreVisualRelationships: Large-scale outlined text framing the subject from above
High-contrast black silhouettes against a flat pink field
Horizontal alignment of figures creating a stable baseline
Negative space used to emphasize the graphic quality of the figures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four figures occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled to allow the header text significant breathing room.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, outlined title text at the top edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large top text, drop to the four figures, and scan horizontally across their poses.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The solid pink background acts as a massive field of negative space, flattening the depth of the image.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for photographic shadows and outlines
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation pink with zero-value black creates a vibrating, psychedelic effect.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold rounded sans-serif with psychedelic flourishes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'i' dots are perfectly circular and large
Ascenders and descenders are shortened to maintain a blocky header shape
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary small, heavy italic sans-serif for metadata to provide a sharp contrast to the soft main title.
graphicDevices: Horizontal bar/railing as a grounding element

candidateDirections.reason: Similar geometric roundness and heavy presence

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photo of four men in 1970s attire sitting on a metal rail, then apply a duotone filter using bubblegum pink for the whites and solid black for the shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, custom-lettered bubble font outline across the top, ensuring the letters are transparent to the pink background.

verificationChecks: Is the pink background perfectly flat?
Are the figures rendered in pure black without gray mid-tones?

mustRedesign: Remove specific band member faces to avoid likeness issues
Replace specific logos with generic geometric shapes
Change specific text content to generic placeholders
postGenerationChecks: Check for any accidental color bleeding outside the pink/black palette
Ensure text is legible despite being outline-only
Verify the 'threshold' effect on the people is sharp and not blurry
recipe.reuseFormula: Duotone High-Contrast Photography + Overlapping Bubble Outline Header
